title: ?矩亭
subtitle: Qichun Yuan

model.line: A plain box on the block drawn on the Qing plan S01: position and frontage from the plan, heights and roof from the typology of its hall class. It will be updated as the research goes on.
rows: platform 0.48 m, eave 3.68 m, ridge 6.24 m above the ground

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum and Historical Photographs of China; today's photographs on Commons. No text or drawing names it in 養吉齋叢錄 j18, modern studies of 绮春园, what search indexes show of the Yangshi Lei drawings; 日下旧闻考 does not cover this garden, and Jiaqing's 三十景 poems could not be reached (wishlist).

plan_ref.text: Drawn on the plan of the gardens (S01), labelled ?矩亭 (? marks an unread character), 1x1 cells.
